messages:
Anya: Quick q — should onboarding benchmarks run on the same runtime as production (to catch perf regressions) or in an isolated bench cluster (reproducible, cheaper)? thinking about KV cache + streaming effects.
Miguel: Both have pros. In-runtime catches real contention and kernel-level regressions but is noisy. Isolated bench gives reproducible numbers and easier signal. I'd lean hybrid if we can keep interfaces clean.
Samir: We sketched something like that in the RFC but never defined the adapter boundary. Proposal: a 'bench-adapter' plugin with two modes: 'live-proxy' and 'replay'. live-proxy = route a tiny controlled fraction of bench inputs to canary runtime instances. replay = deterministic replay on bench workers with pinned seq-lens/quantized kernels.
Anya: Agree. Interface should be minimal so infra + runtime don't need deep coupling. bench-run request shape could be: 
```
{
  "model_id": "rwd-7b-v2",
  "input_set_id": "golden-12",
  "mode": "replay|live-proxy",
  "timeout_ms": 120000,
  "sample_seed": 42
}
```
Miguel: If we add a mode switch, need auth + quotas for live-proxy (can't accidentally DOS canaries). Also runtime should expose a lightweight probe endpoint that bypasses heavy batching and returns per-call micro-metrics (kernel timings, kv-hit, peak-mem). Make it optional behind a flag.
BenchBot: bench-run started: run_id=br-20250317-97, mode=replay, inputs=golden-12, estimated=12m
Samir: Two other tradeoffs: 1) tail latency: live-proxy is the only way to measure it under real workload shapes but you need traffic shaping to avoid skew; 2) golden inputs drift — we should version golden sets and add a golden-expiry field plus periodic reselection + human review.
Anya: Action items: Miguel -> draft probe endpoint spec and auth model; Samir -> prototype bench-adapter interface + shim; I'll write gating policy that decides accept/reject based on relative deltas (p50/p95/p99 + generation-quality hit rate). timeline: aim for initial drafts next week :calendar:.
Miguel: sg. putting a draft doc here: https://redwood.internal/drive/onboard/bench-adapter-draft. I'll also ping infra for proxy quotas and canary tagging rules.
Samir: I'll aim for a tiny PR with interface types + example implementation by Fri. ping me if you want pairing.
Anya: :thumbsup: thanks — keeping this thread for followups and decisions.
